entries.name: n8n MCP server (docs-only key-less)
entries.description: Tier-1 n8n workflow tooling via the external n8n-mcp server. The docs-only path is key-less; live workflow management still needs the human-gated n8n API key.

entries.name: Playwright MCP server (API-less fallback)
